recipes.literal: JSON null, booleans, strings, safe-integer numbers, arrays and objects are used as written, in schemas and in values; members may hold recipes
recipes.$decimal: number(token); the result must be a Decimal
recipes.$number: number(token); the result may be a primitive
recipes.$native: a binary64 number literal of the host language, in a schema or a value
recipes.$base64: base64(bytes) over the listed byte values
recipes.$base64ThenMutate: base64(bytes), then the source array is overwritten
recipes.$hex: encoded(bytes, hex) where hex.length is 2 * byteLength and hex.encode is lowercase hexadecimal; the runner counts encoderCalls
recipes.$nest: an array nested n levels deep around 0
recipes.$external: external(value, access) of the built member: a frozen, authenticated graph
recipes.$foreign: for the foreign adapter: host storage holding the built Encoded's bytes and encoder, served through deferredString
recipes.$foreignText: for the scalar adapter: host storage holding a string, served through scalar
recipes.$foreignNumber: for the foreign adapter: host storage holding a number token, served through numberToken

input.value: the instance (recipes allowed); for op compile absent
input.times: validate is called this many times on one compiled schema; counters are the total; every call's costs must equal its own delta
input.access: an adapter name: shipped (access from @openbindings/json/advanced), foreign (deferredString and numberToken over $foreign and $foreignNumber wrappers), scalar (strings through scalar, reasons recorded), kindThrows, badVersion
input.mutateAfterCompile: after compile and before validate, the caller's schema document is changed at the pointer
input.priorWork: a fresh Encoded is forced before the measured call

expect.valid | codes | pointers: the report's verdict, its error codes in order, their data.pointer values in order
expect.error: the ValueError code thrown by the operation; path and details are its details; causeMessage is cause.message
expect.throws: "library": a non-ValueError Error thrown by the operation (the upstream evaluator's)
expect.messageIncludes | messageExcludes: a substring test on the first error's message, or on the thrown error's message
expect.valueIs: the first error's data.value is the very member of the instance at this JSON Pointer ("" is the root)
expect.kept: after the call, String(member at pointer) is text and moves no counter
expect.encodes | bytesEncoded | bytesCopied | s: the exact delta of that counter across the operation (compile, or all validate calls)
expect.costs (implicit): for every validate, validation.costs equals the counter delta of that call
expect.encoderCalls: how many times the hex encoder ran across the operation
expect.scalarReasons: the reasons the scalar adapter received, in order
expect.frozen: the report and its error list are frozen

notation.languages: absent means every language; ["typescript"] means the recipe or observable is host-specific
